title: Planning Your Future
text: Explore how learning, skills, and qualifications support your future and how planning helps you achieve your goals.
cdi_links: 3.G.02 Being aware that learning, skills and qualifications are important for career development

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: Why learning, skills, and qualifications are important
How planning helps you achieve your goals
The difference between short-term and long-term planning
How to take steps towards your future career

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain why skills and qualifications are important
I can describe what planning means
I can identify short-term and long-term goals
I can create simple steps towards my future

title: Key Words
bullets: Planning – Thinking ahead and deciding the steps needed to reach a goal
Goal – Something you want to achieve in the future
Short-term – Steps you can take soon, such as this week or this term
Long-term – Bigger steps that take more time, such as a year or more

title: Quick Questions
bullets: What skills do you already have?
What is something you would like to achieve in the future?
Why might planning be important?

title: Planning Your Next Steps
bullets: Planning is thinking ahead and deciding steps to reach your goals
Without planning, it is easy to lose focus
Short-term planning focuses on small, achievable steps
Long-term planning focuses on bigger goals, such as careers
Example: Learn a recipe this week (short-term) → become a chef (long-term)

title: Why Planning Matters
bullets: Skills and qualifications are important, but planning helps you achieve them
Planning helps you feel in control of your future
It builds confidence and direction
Thinking ahead helps you make better decisions

title: Activity
text: Complete a range of tasks to practise planning for your future.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Skills and qualifications help you succeed in your career
Planning helps you take the right steps towards your goals
Short-term and long-term planning work together
Thinking ahead helps you make better choices for your future
